scope: Phase 3.2 disposable real integration lab readiness and deterministic Compose lifecycle

criteria.description: The exact Phase 3 prompt, frozen source HEAD and current audit are recorded without changing the frozen acceptance bar
criteria.limitations: Entry and implementation-readiness evidence only; no runtime or release promotion is claimed

criteria.description: The public Phase 3 plan defines ordered P0/P1/P2 runtime, evidence, review and authority gates
criteria.limitations: The plan does not assert that blocked external services or human decisions already exist

criteria.description: Canonical local CI, static, contract and frontend checks are known; the Compose lab validates the required topology and remains fail-closed when runtime dependencies are unavailable
criteria.limitations: Local verification does not prove remote CI execution, service readiness, distributed durability or production deployment

conditions.description: The disposable Docker daemon and approved runtime endpoints must be available before live readiness or P0 runtime evidence is classified
conditions.impact: Without a disposable daemon, Compose startup, health/readiness probes and teardown remain unexecuted external evidence
conditions.due_or_trigger: Before any live P0 gate or production promotion decision
conditions.verification_method: Run make up and make down against the approved disposable daemon and retain bounded health/log observations

conditions.description: Disposable runtime secrets and endpoint authority must be injected only through the approved private configuration path
conditions.impact: No live external service or provider evidence may be inferred from placeholder environment examples
conditions.due_or_trigger: When the disposable integration lab is authorized for execution
conditions.verification_method: Bind the private disposable env file, verify the selected Compose project and run the live endpoint probes without committing credentials

authority.scope: Phase 3.2 disposable real integration lab readiness and deterministic Compose lifecycle
authority.decision: Local implementation is authorized by the current Phase 3 objective; daemon, secrets and production authority remain separate
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Any Compose topology, host permission, external runtime or promotion scope change

next_action: Obtain approved disposable Docker access, execute make up/readiness/down and bind the raw observations to P0-03
revalidation_triggers: A Compose service, healthcheck, image, project or volume changes
The host Docker socket or environment authority changes
A live startup or teardown result is observed
